working_title: When Inlier Ranking Fails to Control Gallery Influence in Frozen Few-Shot Classification

narrative_strategy.central_thesis: In a controlled gallery-only transfer of open-set prototype fitting, good inlier ranking can coexist with harmful accumulated weight from task-external samples.
narrative_strategy.central_insight: The aggregate mass and composition retained by a prototype update must be examined separately from ranking quality.
narrative_strategy.reader_takeaway: Evaluate relevance scores, total retained weight and strong classifier controls jointly before treating an unlabeled gallery as beneficial.

story_spine.problem: Independent unlabeled galleries can contain many classes outside a few-shot episode.
story_spine.gap: Open-set weighting can rank relevant samples well without ensuring that the total retained contribution of irrelevant samples is small.
story_spine.method: Evaluate a gallery-only transfer of established open-set prototype fitting, decompose its final averaging coefficients, and intervene separately on gallery mass and class composition.
story_spine.main_result: The source-default transfer underperforms strong local controls in two image-disjoint Pets pools; high inlier ranking quality coexists with dominant task-external weight.
story_spine.scope_limit: One target dataset, one frozen feature fusion, two gallery sources and fixed source defaults. The interventions are retrospective and oracle composition uses unavailable labels.

insight_ladder.statement: Source-default transfer fails a strong-control qualification even though it improves on closed-set fitting.
insight_ladder.risk: A restricted transfer cannot stand in for the source method's original benchmark.

insight_ladder.statement: Ranking separation and total contaminant weight answer different questions.
insight_ladder.risk: Averaging coefficients do not measure causal or directional importance.

insight_ladder.statement: Changing final mass reduces mismatch harm while class composition retains explanatory value.
insight_ladder.risk: Post hoc interventions do not qualify a new algorithm.

observed_facts: OSLO_G is below R2 in all eight cells, including paired negative matched one-shot effects in both pools.
Mean matched one-shot inlier AUROC is about 0.93 but about 80% of gallery weight remains on task-external classes.
Mass balancing largely rescues mismatch but still loses matched one-shot; privileged composition filtering improves matched one-shot.
Separate source calibration failed its bidirectional gate and matched the same-mass control at prediction level.
allowed_interpretations: Total retained mass can remain harmful despite favorable inlier ranking.
Mass and composition have distinguishable effects in this constrained final-step diagnostic.
must_not_claim: Causal directional importance from scalar averaging coefficients
evidence_gaps: No second target dataset for OSLO transfer
No independent sampling uncertainty over domains
No broad hyperparameter or gallery-size sensitivity

core_claims.claim: With fixed source defaults, gallery-only open-set fitting does not improve over R2 in the evaluated Pets conditions.
core_claims.scope: Eight cells across two fixed, image-disjoint same-domain pools, matched or DTD galleries and one or five support examples per class.
core_claims.what_would_falsify_it: A reproducible positive paired effect over R2 in an asserted cell, or a source/identity/permission mismatch invalidating the comparison.

core_claims.claim: Strong inlier ranking coexists with substantial total task-external gallery weight in the evaluated matched-gallery transfer.
core_claims.scope: Final fitted weights under the source-default gallery transfer; conditional descriptive statistics.
core_claims.what_would_falsify_it: Incorrect class membership or weight accounting, failed prediction replay, or negligible retained external mass in these conditions.

core_claims.claim: Final-step mass balancing alleviates mismatch degradation but does not close the matched one-shot gap; privileged composition removal gives a separate diagnostic gain.
core_claims.scope: Retrospective interventions with earlier fitted weights and feature geometry held fixed.
core_claims.what_would_falsify_it: Mass balancing closes the matched one-shot strong-control gap, oracle filtering gives no diagnostic gain, or original predictions fail exact replay.

core_claims.claim: A fixed source-trained membership calibrator with prior correction fails the two-direction development-transfer gate and yields no prediction benefit over a same-mass control.
core_claims.scope: Frozen features; historically exposed DTD and EuroSAT pools; paired one- and five-shot conditions. Separate from the OSLO experiment.
core_claims.what_would_falsify_it: Different same-mass predictions or a reproducible paired gate pass under the locked protocol, or an invalid source/task comparison.
